turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 CRO Submission Export (WuXi AppTec) — Validates cardiac safety, computes physicochemical properties, and formats all 5 ranked BCR-ABL1 compounds into a WuXi AppTec-ready CSV export.

Input: 5 compounds with SMILES — Asciminib (#1), Bosutinib (#2), Imatinib (#3), Gleevec-analog-2 (#4), Gleevec-analog-1 (#5) — plus IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores from the BCR-ABL1 campaign ranking
Key steps:

hERG cardiac safety gate → flags any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM for exclusion (all 5 must pass)
RDKit property calculation → computes MW and LogP from SMILES for each compound
WuXi AppTec formatter → maps compound_id, SMILES, IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), composite score, MW, LogP into the CRO column schema and exports CSV


Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (submission-ready, one row per compound) + metadata.json (run provenance, safety-gate pass/fail log per compound)

Decision gate: hERG IC50 must exceed 1 μM for all 5 compounds — any compound failing this threshold is automatically excluded from the export and flagged in the metadata log before the CSV is written.
Required inputs

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)

Next step

Confirm the intended analysis priority and upload the required inputs so I can produce a runnable, decision-ready workflow.
